actions.name: execute_python

parameters.description: The code to run. Can be a file ID from within Shuffle.
parameters.name: code
parameters.value:
import re
import json

win_ip_field = "$exec.all_fields.data.win.eventdata.ipAddress"
suricata_ip_field = "$exec.all_fields.data.src_ip"
hashes_field = "$exec.all_fields.data.win.eventdata.hashes"
rule_groups = '''$exec.all_fields.rule.groups'''
agent_ip = "$exec.all_fields.agent.ip"
vt_sha1 = "$exec.all_fields.data.virustotal.sha1"
vt_file = r'''$exec.all_fields.data.virustotal.source.file'''
vt_pos = "$exec.all_fields.data.virustotal.positives"
vt_total = "$exec.all_fields.data.virustotal.total"
file_clean = vt_file.replace("\\", "/")
alert_title = r'''$exec.title'''.replace("\\", "/").replace('"', "'")

malware_confirmed = "no"

if "ransomware" in rule_groups:
    obs_type = "ransomware"
    obs_value = agent_ip
elif "virustotal" in rule_groups and vt_sha1.strip():
    obs_type = "hash"
    obs_value = vt_sha1
    malware_confirmed = "yes"
elif win_ip_field.strip():
    obs_type = "ip"
    obs_value = win_ip_field
elif suricata_ip_field.strip():
    obs_type = "ip"
    obs_value = suricata_ip_field
elif hashes_field.strip():
    match = re.search(r"SHA256=([A-Fa-f0-9]+)", hashes_field)
    if match:
        obs_type = "hash"
        obs_value = match.group(1)
    else:
        obs_type = "other"
        obs_value = agent_ip
else:
    obs_type = "other"
    obs_value = agent_ip

print(json.dumps({
    "obs_type": obs_type,
    "obs_value": obs_value,
    "malware_confirmed": malware_confirmed,
    "file": file_clean,
    "vt_positives": vt_pos,
    "vt_total": vt_total,
    "alert_title": alert_title
}))

parameters.value:
import re
import json

raw = '''$get_reports_hash'''

m = re.search(r'"last_analysis_stats"\s*:\s*\{[^}]*?"malicious"\s*:\s*(\d+)', raw)
malicious_count = int(m.group(1)) if m else 0

n = re.search(r'"meaningful_name"\s*:\s*"([^"]*)"', raw)
file_name = n.group(1) if n else "inconnu"

result = {"malicious": malicious_count, "name": file_name}
print(json.dumps(result))
